name: iam:CreateLoginProfile
description: Create a console login profile for a target IAM user to gain access to their permissions via the AWS Console
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target IAM user must be in the Resource section

additional.description: Check if user already has login profile

admin: Target user must NOT currently have a login profile
Target user must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
lateral: Target user must NOT currently have a login profile

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: TARGET_USER
options.description: Target IAM user name to create login profile for

options.name: PASSWORD
options.description: Password for the login profile (auto-generated if not provided)

options.name: NO_PASSWORD_RESET
options.description: Skip password reset requirement on first login (true/false)

options.name: ADMIN_ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of a role to assume before calling iam:CreateLoginProfile (required when starting as a user without direct CreateLoginProfile permission)
